podcast.title: Independent Single
podcast.body: In April 1978, this "goofy group out of Athens, Georgia" released an independent single version of "Rock Lobster." It featured Ricky Wilson on a Mosrite guitar interplaying with a Farfisa organ and notably lacked a bass line. "In April 1978, a goofy group out of Athens, Georgia, who dressed like they were on their way to an early 60s Tupperware party after taking big tabs of acid, released an independent single."
